Mrs. Belding (guest star Louan Gideon) goes into labor while trapped in an elevator with Zack and Tori (Mark-Paul Gosselaar, Leanna Creel).
Zack, Slater, Screech and Lisa (Mark-Paul Gosselaar, Mario Lopez, Dustin Diamond, Lark Voorhies) reflect on the summer they spent at Malibu Sands.
Zack enters a contest to write a new school song and resorts to sabotage.
Teens from the TV series visit a grandfather's (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen) Hawaiian resort, under siege by a greedy developer.
California college students from the TV series trek to Las Vegas for the nuptials of Kelly (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen) and Zack (Mark-Paul Gosselaar).

Zack's high-school girlfriend (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen) moves into the same suite as his new love interest (Anne Tremko). With Mark-Paul Gosselaar.
For a cultural anthropology class, Zack (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) tries to find out what women want. With Patrick Fabian.
Zack and Slater (Mark-Paul Gosselaar, Mario Lopez) are invited to join the Sigma Alpha fraternity. With Dustin Diamond.
Slater (Mario Lopez) battles with his feelings when he is challenged to take part in a protest. With Mark-Paul Gosselaar.
The university's most famous alumnus (Charles Grant) makes advances toward Kelly (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen). Guest stars: Gloria Loring, Ed Winter.
Kelly, Leslie and Alex (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen, Anne Tremko, Kiersten Warren) give Mr. Rogers (Bob Golic) some advice about women.
Zack (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) poses as Professor Lasky (Patrick Fabian) to get a date with a fellow student (Brittney Powell).
Zack and Screech (Mark-Paul Gosselaar, Dustin Diamond) fall in love with the same tennis player (Hillary Danner).
Kelly (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen) has a personality change when she works as a waitress. With Mark-Paul Gosselaar.
Zack, Slater, Alex and Kelly (Mark-Paul Gosselaar, Mario Lopez, Kiersten Warren, Tiffani-Amber Thiessen) spend Thanksgiving with underprivileged children.
Kelly and Professor Lasky (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen, Patrick Fabian) discover a mutual attraction.
Kelly (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen) asks Professor Lasky (Patrick Fabian) to her sorority masquerade ball.
Zack, Slater, Alex and Leslie (Mark-Paul Gosselaar, Mario Lopez, Kiersten Warren, Anne Tremko) take an ethics course with a difficult professor (guest star Robert Guillaume).
Zack (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) has a party to raise money for a trip to Cancun, Mexico. With Holland Taylor.
Zack (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) takes a part-time job at the Student Health Center to be close to Kelly (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen).
Each of the students tries to deal with the death of a popular professor. With Mark-Paul Gosselaar and Mario Lopez.
Zack (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) panics at the thought of losing Kelly (Tiffani-Amber Thiessen) and asks her to marry him.
Lisa (guest star Lark Voorhies) visits California University for Kelly's wedding shower. With Tiffani-Amber Thiessen.
Zack's summer romance with an older woman comes to a halt when she discovers he lied to her.
Zack promises to help Screech get a date with Lisa if Screech will do Zack's term paper.
Zack tries to cash in on a stock-market investment to get money to replace his father's video recorder.
A student opposed to killing animals for experiments releases all the science class frogs.
Zack's father falls for Miss Bliss.
Screech finds that an intimidating student has a learning disability.
Zack and a classmate ask the same girl to an upcoming dance, jeopardizing their friendship.
Zack's (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) scheme to get more time to study for a midterm ends up hurting his teacher. With Dennis Haskins.
A student argument helps a teacher resolve a problem with a longtime friend. With Mark-Paul Gosselaar and Dustin Diamond.
A teacher turns a practical joke into a lesson about the criminal justice system. With Mark-Paul Gosselaar and Dustin Diamond.
Zack (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) schemes to steal a kiss from a returning former student who is now a famous rock star.
Zack (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) is offered a chance to join a popular club. With Dustin Diamond.
A retired teacher with unorthodox methods stimulates the class when he substitutes for their regular teacher.
The gang enters a dance contest being held at the Max and hosted by radio personality Casey Kasem. With Mark-Paul Gosselaar and Dustin Diamond.
Lisa's (Lark Voorhies) friends invent ways to pay the bills she has accrued on her father's credit card. With Tiffani-Amber Thiessen and Mark-Paul Gosselaar.
A freak lightning accident enables Screech (Dustin Diamond) to predict the future. With Tiffani-Amber Thiessen and Mario Lopez.
The guys hide a microphone at the girls' party to find out whom Kelly will ask to the dance.
Zack (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) gets into unusual circumstances and clothes when he tries to help Screech (Dustin Diamond) get a date.

Screech's (Dustin Diamond) house party turns into a disaster when his mother's favorite statue is broken. With Mark-Paul Gosselaar.

Jessie (Elizabeth Berkley) becomes addicted to caffeine pills as she strives to be a perfect student. With Mark-Paul Gosselaar, Tiffani-Amber Thiessen.

Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May are challenged to knock down a row of derelict houses in less time than it takes a team of demolition; Jeremy tests an updated version of the classic Jensen Interceptor.
The guys try to make a secondhand car lap a test track as fast as a new sports car.
The New Bus for London; Range Rover.
Jeremy Clarkson is at the high-tech testing ground for Formula One Circuit Paul Ricard.
Jeremy Clarkson takes the Kia Cee'd on a road test; a game of rugby with James May.
The guys race from London to Edinburgh, traveling by locomotive, motorbike and a Jaguar XK120.
Search for a mid-engined Italian supercar for less than 10,000 British pounds; Pagani Zonda F; record-breaking yachtswoman Ellen MacArthur.
Jeremy Clarkson and Richard Hammond look at some second-hand bargains for the price of Britain's cheapest brand-new car, the £6,995 Nissan Pixo.
Finding the perfect car for a seventeen-year-old; a race between a McLaren F1 and a Bugatti Veyron.
In search of the River Nile's source.
Testing the Tesla Model 3, Volvo S60 and BMW 3-Series by spending 24 hours in them; Chris heads to Italy to test the Ferrari SF90.
The presenters are ordered to make their cars road legal, and report to a monstrous Wall of Death; the presenters each choose a 200mph legend for a trip.
The cheapest rental cars in Europe are on the island of Cyprus; for just 30 Euros, the crew embark on a series of destructive challenges.
A staycation for Paddy, Freddie and Chris, as they drive British grand tourers on Wales's roads; Chris Harris pays tribute to Sir Stirling Moss and his battles against Ferrari.
An all-electric, all-terrain ice cream van that sweeps streets and has an on-board rubber ring for aquatic delivery.

A compilation of the fastest cars; Chris Harris heads to Italy to test the Ferrari SF90; the team test the battery operated Honda E, Vauxhall Corsa E and Mini electric; a tribute to the late Sir Sterling Moss.
Freddie, Chris and Paddy head to the Lake District for an emotional reunion with their own dads' old cars; Chris heads out on track to test Lamborghini's most powerful car ever, the hybrid Sian.
The team try out some of James Bond's greatest cars, including the legendary Aston Martin DB5.
Freddie, Chris and Paddy head on an icy expedition across the wild Scottish Highlands in the new Land Rover Defender, Mercedes G-Wagen and Ariel Nomad.

Freddie, Chris and Paddy confront the male midlife crisis by buying the perfect sports cars for "gentlemen of a certain age;" back at the track, Chris tests out the raucous new Toyota GR Yaris hot hatch.
Team Top Gear is up against the Florida locals in events including donk-car drag racing, a swamp buggy shoot-out, all ending up at the Freedom Factory Raceway for a NASCAR-style showdown.
On a mission to give the trundling trailblazer Sinclair one more eccentric adventure, Fred attempts to break the national speed limit whilst piloting the C5 down an Olympic bobsleigh run.
Chris, Freddie, and Paddy decide to get their lorry licenses, and become fully fledged HGV drivers themselves.

The team finds out if it is possible to get a reliable used car for less than £500; Chris lives the high life in Maserati's new MC20 supercar, while Freddie goes on the charge in the all-electric Rivian pick-up truck.
Freddie, Chris, and Paddy celebrate 100 years of the BBC by tackling motorsport 1920s-style.

America loves pick-up trucks, but there's a country even more obsessed with them than the U.S., and that's Thailand; Chris Harris tests the Rimac Nevera, a 2,000 horsepower all-electric car from Croatia.
The hosts set out to build a bridge over the River Kwai in Thailand, but must first drive across Burma.
A railroad tycoon and his younger brother (Peter Falk, Tommy Sands) trap Chris Hale in the middle of a family conflict.
A Chinese princess offers to adopt Cooper Smith and provide him with a bride.
A British newspaper reporter (Michael Rennie) rides along on the wagon train to observe the Wild West. Brian Keith also guest stars.
A woman (Beverly Owen) tries to save her sister (Suzanne Pleshette) from a miserable life in a mining town.
Two desperados bring an adolescent sidekick along to a bank robbery.
Cooper learns that his girlfriend Rose's (Annette Funicello) brother is a Brooklyn criminal.
The Bancroft gang robs a family of emigrants of all their possessions.
A woman (Diana Hyland) faces a death sentence after her married boyfriend is found murdered during a cross-country journey. Bradford Dillman also guest stars.
Slim goes on the hunt for the shooters after returning to the ranch to find Jess and a stage executive shot.
Bob Blayne's sons come looking for Jess, bent on revenge because Jess maimed their father years ago; though Jess tries to avoid a shootout, when Slim is injured Jess is forced into action.
Slim investigates when a ranch fight leads to death, but Slim is not convinced the Arapaho chief found with the body is the killer.
Though they don't trust him, Slim and Jess are forced to watch an injured ex-con who was forced to assist in a bank robbery.
While on the trail with a couple facing financial issues, Jess and the couple find a mule loaded with sacks of gold.
Jim investigates killing during robbery.
Hardie goes undercover to the town of Alder Gulch to investigate stagecoach robberies.

Jim is sent to Moose Creek, Canada, to identify the corpse of an outlaw only he has seen, but the man was killed with a shotgun blast to the face, which makes him hard to identify; a woman claims the body is her brother's body.
The son of a dead man accused of a stage coach robbery finds an empty strongbox in the attic and hopes that Jim Hardie can help him uncover the real thieves.
Hardie gives a job to the son of a former employee who was fired.
Hardie tries to prevent a lynching when a town's hard cases accuse a Basque sheepherder of the abduction of a young girl.
Jim goes undercover as a trainee for Wells Fargo, to try and find out who is supplying renegade Indians with the guns they are using on their murderous raids.
Hardie isn't pleased when a man and beautiful woman insist on becoming passengers on the stagecoach he will use.
Jim Hardie is ordered to infiltrate Sam Bass' gang so that he can learn where they hole up between raids.
Jim Hardie is called in to investigate what happened to a long overdue stagecoach; among passengers were the son of a wealthy rancher and his fiancée.
Jim Hardie joins a group of passengers aboard a stagecoach that includes a woman and her son, a reporter and an outlaw.
When Jesse James and his gang are suspected of robbing a bank in Missouri, Jim Hardie goes undercover to try to find the outlaw.
Hardie is called to investigate when a Wells Fargo agent dies and a large sum of money is determined to be missing from the man's office.
Outlaw Belle Starr and her gang rob a train on which Jim Hardie is a passenger, and he tries to lure her from hiding by tempting her with a prominent racehorse.

A rookie outlaw holds up the stage carrying cash that Jim is waiting for, prompting Jim to go off looking for the thief, but he finds he needs the criminal's help when the two must evade an Indian attack.
Jim joins a father who's searching for his missing son in the Superstition Mountains -- an area held sacred by the Apaches.
As the only witness to a robbery, Hardie is targeted by the robber's partner.
A woman must protect herself and her daughter from a callous man.
A gang joins the train in the guise of farmers and plans to take it over.
While in the desert, Cooper finds a prospector who is lost and near death from exposure and thirst.
While traveling with Chris Hale's wagon train, a young woman (Laraine Day) with a criminal past is blamed for the theft of a passenger's money.
An Army deserter turns himself in to leaders of the wagon train.
A jewelry shop owner sells a rare black pearl to a client, who later returns looking for another one to make a matched pair.
Having had a bad run of luck, a man (Howard Morris) tracks down an old college friend (Jack Carter) in hopes of landing a job.
A husband searches desperately for his wife in a neighborhood where numerous murders have been committed.
A shoplifter (Coleen Gray) is blackmailed into helping the store manager (Richard Long) in a crime of his own.
A meek clerk (Dick York) plots with his associates to rob their investment firm. With Wendell Holmes.
A wanted man (Jack Carson) disappears while visiting a little-known tourist attraction in Italy. With Christopher Dark.
A recently-divorced man (Robert Webber) makes a deal with a friend (Jeremy Slate) to avoid having to pay alimony.
A man (Wayne Rogers) decides to demonstrate to his new-found girlfriend (Anne Helm) how he gets his kicks. With Brian Hutton.
A housekeeper make arrangements to keep her lover all to herself when he expresses interest in another woman.
On the eve of her final vows, Sister Pamela (Carol Lynley) must pick up a statue donated by an ex-mobster.
A man (Dean Stockwell), determined to win the affection of a married woman (Susan Oliver), accidentally kills her husband (Henry Brandt).
A conniving man (Robert Sterling) blackmails a schoolmaster (Macdonald Carey) who has been led to believe he's an accomplice to murder.
A mugging jogs the memory of an amnesiac (Richard Basehart) who remembers he is being sought for murder.
Plagued by a guilty conscience, a man (Barry Sullivan) confesses to his wife's murder, but his words fall on deaf ears.
A crime returns to haunt a man (Hugh O'Brian) when boyhood pals escape from prison. With Gena Rowlands.
A man's (Tony Randall) drinking causes blackouts during which he loses both his job and his wife. With Jayne Mansfield.
A greedy preacher (Peter Falk) lets an elderly woman die, then pursues her heiress niece. With Dina Merrill.
A woman (Linda Purl) is attacked in her home and her husband (David Clennon) takes the law into his own hands.
Two retired insurance salesmen (Robert H. Harris, John Qualen) expect murder when the temperature reaches 92 degrees.
A young man (John Forsythe) returns home after an absence of four years to investigate his father's death.
A woman (Ellen Corby) tries to prevent a shootout between two gunslingers (Darren McGavin, Gene Barry).
A determined detective (Robert Emhardt) uncovers a man's scheme to have his "missing" wife declared legally dead.
A woman (Patricia Hitchcock) visiting Paris returns to her hotel room to find her ailing mother missing.
A gangster (Gene Barry) plans to punish the woman (Nancy Gates) he feels is responsible for his brother's death.
A businessman, injured in a car crash and believed by everyone to be dead, fights to signal he is alive.
A man (Everett Sloane) suspects his cook (Beulah Bondi) of being an arsenic-poisoning murderer. With Janet Ward.
A down-on-his-luck man responds to a newspaper ad from a man seeking a companion for a cross-country trip.
A man (Tom Ewell) believes an exact double is gradually taking over his life.
A woman (Judith Evelyn) is suspected of murdering her husband, who has been having an affair with another woman. With Joe Mantell and Kathleen McGuire.
A larcenous store Santa (Barry Fitzgerald) helps change the ways of a potential delinquent (Bobby Clark).
A man (Darren McGavin) tries to trick an elderly woman (Patricia Collinge) out of a family heirloom.
A man (John Qualen) is surprised to learn that the boss he thought he had murdered is still alive. With Philip Reed.
A gunman (George Mathews), intent on murdering his girlfriend, purchases an alibi.
An escaped convict (John Cassavetes) takes refuge in a farmhouse occupied by a young housewife (Marisa Pavan).
A year after the murders, a newspaper reporter (Joan Lorring) attempts to interview Lizzie Borden (Carmen Mathews) and her sister about the killings.
A bum (Robert Newton) witnesses a murder and decide to take advantage of the situation. With Philip Reed.
A police detective (Charles Bronson) investigating a murder focuses on a strange ventriloquist (Claude Rains).
A female reporter (Claire Trevor) encounters problem trying to leave Eastern Europe after meeting a soccer star.
A man (Mark Damon) arrives at a monastery bent on revenge and is convinced by a kind priest (Everett Sloane) to mend his heart.
An English man (John Williams) murders his wife and moves to California, thinking he has committed the perfect crime.
Two greedy brothers plan to murder their elderly aunt (Mildred Natwick) in an attempt to inherit her money.
A desperate couple (Charles Bronson, Norma Crane) plans to rob an eccentric old woman (Estelle Winwood).
An angel (Alan Napier) allows a murdered mystery writer (John Williams) to return to Earth to uncover his killer.
An unemployed man (John Qualen) needing money is hired by an unknown employer (Lorne Greene) to commit murder.
A man (Philip Abbott) is startled to see a portrait of his first wife four years after she disappeared.
An antiques dealer (Robert H. Harris) decides his art objects are too beautiful to sell. With Louise Larabee.
An insecure woman (Phyllis Thaxter) who can't control her drinking loses control at a cocktail party.
Using a haunted house in their ploy, two men (Ralph Clanton, John Irving) scheme to con a wealthy American (Biff McGuire) out of his money.
A garrulous babysitter (Thelma Ritter) enjoys being the center of attention after her employer is murdered.
A murderer (Jack Mullaney) hides from a posse after killing a school teacher's (Pat Hitchcock) fiancé.
A man (Biff McGuire) struggles to remember the license plate number of the vehicle that killed his fiancée (Judith Ames).
While vacationing in Palm Beach, a reserved heiress (Leora Dana) becomes the romantic focus of a prince (Jacques Bergerac).
A woman (Ruth Hussey) is stunned to learn that a mink coat she bought had been stolen from a previous owner.
An executive (Howard Duff) plans to end an associate's (Dan Dailey) love affair and save the man's career and marriage.
A suspicious sergeant (William Conrad) digs when a death is labeled accidental. With David Wayne.
A woman (Anne Francis) stands trial for her husband's murder, and the family maid (Ruth Roman) holds the key to the truth.

Problems arise when a leader convinces his men to take the law into their own hands.

A notorious killer escapes from jail hoping to recover his treasure and kill the Lone Ranger and Tonto.
The Lone Ranger and Tonto search for three brothers who have escaped from prison.
A young prince learns that his uncle is planning to kill him and become heir to the throne.
Trouble erupts with some ranch hands when two American Indians try to cross a property line on their way to sign a peace treaty.

The Lone Ranger and Tonto track two elusive bandits who have been stealing gold shipments.
The masked man (Clayton Moore) and Tonto (Jay Silverheels) catch a greedy rancher (Lyle Bettger) plotting to break an Indian treaty.

Outlaws demand their leader's release in return for a boy's life.
Greedy hunter steals a war-horse.

Tonto becomes a murder target.
Two greenhorns from the East are blamed for murder and claim jumping.
The Lone Ranger teaches an important lesson to a man who's sensitive about his short stature.
Tonto and the Lone Ranger reveal an imposter's true identity.
A bitter man returns home after finishing a prison sentence for a crime he didn't commit.
The Lone Ranger risks his life for a man framed into robbing a bank.
A disguised outlaw, calling himself the Lone Ranger, commits murder.
A crook impersonates Old Joe.
A stagecoach driver seeks the Lone Ranger's help when her assistant is framed for a robbery.
Tonto and the Lone Ranger are puzzled by an old friend's disappearance.
A man runs a "town" as a place of refuge for men fleeing from the law.
Secret panel leads to a criminal.
A henpecked man (Stanley Farrar) helps the Lone Ranger and Tonto capture some cattle rustlers.
Boggs can identify a killer.
Dan Reid poses as a shepherd.
A man must prove to the Lone Ranger that he's not guilty of murder.
A banker's nephew is a robbery suspect.
A murder suspect escapes from prison and forces his brother to hide him.
A restaurant owner turns greedy when she discovers there's oil on a ranch.
The Lone Ranger is mistaken for masked outlaw Dude (Frank Fenton).
Claim jumpers plan a robbery.
Outlaws plan to rob the safe which is kept in the office of the town's barber.
The notorious outlaw Butch Cavendish breaks out of jail by taking the warden's son hostage.
Tonto and the Lone Ranger hope to haul a notorious outlaw and his gang to justice for robbing a stagecoach.
Tonto and the Lone Ranger investigate when three deputies disappear while taking prisoners to Abilene.
The Lone Ranger must rely on a timid barber's help to trap two murderers before they can cross the border.
A crooked major (Gene Roth) sells Army rifles to the Indians.
Members of the Knox gang force people to vote for their candidate.
A refinery is attacked by bandits who steal 200 pounds of gold and kill two guards in the process.
The Lone Ranger suspects foul play after he meets two men with red hair under suspicious circumstances.
A convict sends information concerning the whereabouts of a cache of Spanish gold to his daughter.
Donning a disguise, the Lone Ranger attempts to catch a cunning European criminal.
Homesteaders and Indians war.
A notorious outlaw (Douglas Kennedy) gets a pardon from the governor and becomes sheriff.
The governor's daughter is endangered by Stark Durfee, a notorious outlaw.
Sheriff Shattuck is a rustler at night.

Tonto poses as an outlaw Indian.
